methodology.workload: Three private-route synthetic two-operation browsing tasks; no purchases or private accounts.
methodology.policy: Prompt mode sees goal only. Structured mode sees public typed steps. Destination routes are held only by an independent fixture verifier.
methodology.comparison: Executor-only, fixed public plans plus declared deterministic exact-title/context chooser and creative-studio-work → Studio district oracle; zero paid/model calls.
methodology.timing: totalMs includes initial navigation, overlapping planning, runtime, independent verification, pending provider settlement and the final durable completion write. Initial attempt/batch writes, context setup, cleanup and the final timing-metadata write are separate. taskMs ends before provider settlement and final completion persistence. journalMs measures queued attempt-file write operations, not batch writes; it is reported separately and overlaps totalMs.
methodology.cost: Provider-reported OpenRouter account charge plus Jev estimated input tokens at $0.042/M. All attempted calls retained, unknown usage never zero.
methodology.limits: Max six model calls per task; $0.01/task and $0.10/batch are known-spend stop thresholds, not guaranteed pre-call charge caps. Stop cohort on unknown usage.

results.publicGoal: Search for and open "Paper Harbor", then search within that shop for "Copper Finch Notebook" and open its details.

runtime.scope: At most four compiled native search/open or exact-link steps; each requires a changed URL and an observed exact target heading. Completion is not independent task verification.
runtime.metricScope: Counters add explicit wrapper and v3 operations; internal Playwright traffic is excluded. Observation includes browser waits, and condition/event/request timing can overlap. Journal event time is recorded at workflow level, not added again to step eventMs. No fixed inter-step settling or model calls are added.
